acceptance_criteria.criterion: evidence generation must occur after final content commit; no auto-generated stale proof
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_pre_push.py _require_clean_tree + _require_exact_head run against the committed HEAD before any gate; Artifact/Defect Prevention Guards evaluate committed git state, so proof cannot be generated from an uncommitted or earlier state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: preserve verified signing and trusted hosted exact-head proof; no governance bypass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Commits f55a660 and ba92510 carry verified ED25519 git signatures (Farhad5778); hosted Pre-PR Preflight, Trusted Preflight and Quality Gates evidence is unchanged by this candidate (base..head touches no push-safety gate or hosted proof workflow); all six gates green; no check skipped or weakened.

Content binding fails closed on missing/extra entries (foreign-request stale verdict above); rename transitions are covered by tests/test_connector_admission_channel.py::test_rename_cannot_hide_a_source_transition_inside_the_review_path and ::test_rename_plus_modify_requires_the_exact_destination_blob.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: adversarial tests cover bot event approval holds
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Privileged reconcile declares no pull_request_review or pull_request_review_comment triggers, so approval-held bot events cannot wake it; the bounded 5-minute cron is the review-state path: tests/test_hunter_governance_revision.py::test_trusted_governance_review_changes_have_bounded_approval_free_reconciliation.

Any post-receipt byte change (including a formatting pass) changes the review_target digest and the exact head; fail-closed proven by the foreign-request stale verdict and tests/test_exact_head_review_authority.py::test_an_exact_head_comment_does_not_rescue_a_stale_artifact.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Branch issue-591-fast-merge-m2, PR #592; commits f55a660 and ba92510 verified ED25519-signed by Farhad5778.
